mechanism_in_fm: Auto-IgG binding to EL1/EL2 disrupts gap junction homeostasis, triggering extracellular ATP & glutamate release from SGCs.
Auto-IgG blockade of Kir4.1 causes extracellular K+ accumulation in DRG, depolarizing sensory neurons.
CD40-CD40L axis drives B-cell differentiation, somatic hypermutation, and anti-SGC IgG hyper-production (af Ekenstam 2026).
High-affinity IgE binding site; downregulation in blood reflects loss/degranulation of basophil/mast cell pool.
Non-canonical IgG binding (Sanchez 2025) induces mast cell degranulation and IL-6/tryptase release without IgE cross-linking.
Canonical receptor for IgG Fc; mediates immune-complex activation of mast cells, macrophages, and SGCs.
